title: Production build does not run TypeScript type checking
reasoning: The release build script is only `vite build`. Vite transpiles TypeScript but does not perform full TypeScript semantic type checking by default, so a production bundle can be produced even when the TypeScript compiler would report errors. Because TypeScript is part of the toolchain, this leaves release validation weaker than the project likely expects.
recommendation: Change the build script to run TypeScript checking before bundling, for example `tsc --noEmit && vite build`, or add a dedicated typecheck script and make release/CI invoke it before `vite build`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for this package script, and the configured `npm run test` command runs Vitest rather than validating the production build pipeline or TypeScript compiler errors.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI/package-script check that runs the build command and fails on a deliberate TypeScript semantic error, or add a script-level test asserting that the build pipeline includes `tsc --noEmit`.
minimumFixScope: Update `package.json` scripts so the production build path includes TypeScript semantic checking before `vite build`.
